title: Wave Properties
seo_title: Grade 8 Wave Properties Worksheets: Amplitude, Wavelength, Frequency and Wave Speed
standard_text: Use mathematical representations to describe a simple model for waves that includes how the amplitude of a wave is related to the energy in a wave.
meta_desc: Free middle school science worksheets on wave properties (NGSS MS-PS4-1): amplitude, wavelength, frequency and period, wave speed = frequency × wavelength, and how amplitude relates to energy. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_sub: Wave speed = frequency × wavelength. A larger amplitude carries more energy.

faq.q: How is amplitude related to the energy of a wave?
faq.a: A wave with a larger amplitude carries more energy. Doubling the amplitude gives about four times the energy.

faq.q: How do you find wave speed?
faq.a: Multiply the frequency by the wavelength: speed = frequency × wavelength.
No. Waves carry energy. The matter they travel through moves back and forth or up and down but stays in place.
